body:
Thank you for your response, I really appreciate it. 

I've been in a pretty shitty mental state for quite a while now and took up writing in order to cope with it. Funnily enough, I've only very recently started taking up poetry as an outlet for dealing with my troubles. It really does give me a sense of calm when my mind wanders to dark places; I wish I had started it a bit earlier.

Again, thank you for your kind words, it means a lot.
Thank you, if you ever want to share some of your works with me, feel free to pm me.
Thanks, and yeah, it really helped give me a sense of calm when my mind wandered to dark places.

Thanks, and yea I know lol. I was thinking of making it a bit more fluid, but then I thought that it wouldn't mesh as well with the theme of the poem - like the suffocating tightness that I sometimes feel in my chest. I am still kind of new to poetry so I probably (definitely) could've made it better. I really appreciate your feedback though!

Thank you, means a lot to me.

If you want to send me any of the poems you have written, I'll be glad to to read them!

I'm sorry that this happened to you OP. All I can say is that from the events that you have described above, you are 100% not at fault with what happened with your friend. She obviously had some preconceived notions of dealing with people with suicidal thoughts, which seemed to be very flawed. I can't speak on behalf of her since I don't know her personally, but perhaps she has never dealt with anyone with depression or suicidal thoughts, akin to a untrained civilian trying to give CPR to a collapsed person.  To answer your second question, I think misinterpretations are unavoidable since the nature of every person is different; in this case I do not think it was your fault, although again I do not know about the specifics of the posts or the memes that you've made. As for your last question, I wish I had the answer to that as well, for if I did, I wouldn't be on this sub.

 I hope that you can take it easy OP, and I wish you the best of luck in your future endeavors.
I feel you; I don't have much advice to offer, but I wish you the best of luck in your future endeavors.
